note: Unseen synthetic evaluation matrix for V4; all expectations authored before ANY real V4 call. Not a live-model result. Semantic checks require independent human review of the whole suggested change and its actual scope, not just decision matching.

cases.source: Quiero añadir la distancia focal a las cámaras que ya tengo anotadas.
semantic_checks: Do not assume existing cameras were stored under broad Device or Document type
Ask which canonical note type contains the cameras
cases.reason: Saved objects are not proof of a matching registered entity type

cases.source: Ajoute le poids de mes chiens déjà notés, s'il te plaît.
semantic_checks: No guessed target type from existing records
Ask where dogs are represented
cases.reason: Another language and domain with unresolved canonical destination

cases.source: I have notes about cars already; put VIN on all my cars.
semantic_checks: Don't add VIN to unrelated Document or Product notes
Ask which exact note type holds cars
cases.reason: Potentially broad container not equivalent to a car

cases.source: En el tipo Persona quiero añadir el idioma materno.
semantic_checks: Canonical type_id person
One optional string property describing native language
No new person type
cases.reason: User names the actual existing note type

cases.source: Pour mes connaissances, utilise le type Personne que j'ai déjà.
semantic_checks: type_id person
No duplicate type

cases.source: Create notes for each vinyl record I own with its catalog number.
semantic_checks: Independent record entity type, not Document
Catalog number as a supported property
No artificial status subtype
cases.reason: New identifiable artifact kind distinct from umbrella Document

cases.source: Quiero fichas de vehículos pero excluye los que usamos en la oficina automáticamente.
semantic_checks: Do not claim executable automatic exclusion based on a type description
Clarify manual selection versus implemented policy
cases.reason: Schema editing does not implement per-entity selection predicates

cases.source: Un type pour les cadeaux, mais jamais ceux de mes collègues.
semantic_checks: Exclusion of coworkers' gifts cannot be enforced by type name or description
Ask for intended selection policy
cases.reason: General semantic exclusion requirement in French

cases.source: Please create invoice notes that automatically ignore all unpaid invoices.
semantic_checks: No promise to implement an automatic unpaid filter using only schema
Ask for scope support
cases.reason: Status-based subset that requires runtime filtering

cases.source: Si el año que viene me aficiono al buceo, quizá quiera un tipo de notas para inmersiones.
semantic_checks: No immediate schema change
Clarifying future intent or safe abstention is acceptable in semantic review
cases.reason: Temporal hypothetical rather than an immediate request

cases.source: The bicycle in my garage has a new saddle.
semantic_checks: Do not alter the schema
Fact capture belongs to another route

cases.source: Je ne souhaite modifier aucun type de note existant.
semantic_checks: Honor explicit refusal
No previewed mutation

cases.source: Quiero fichas individuales para novelas, con género y número de capítulos.
semantic_checks: Type means novel, not broad Document
genre as text and chapter count as integer
No invented read-state qualifier
cases.reason: Independent specialized entities with explicit properties

cases.source: Je veux créer un type Aquarium avec le volume de chaque bac.
semantic_checks: Aquarium as independent type
Do not invent litres or another measurement unit
May preserve unit in text or ask a follow-up without fabricating precision
cases.reason: One optional field has unspecified unit but type identity is clear

cases.source: Create a type for telescopes and also add a nickname to Person notes.
semantic_checks: Do not silently discard either of two requested operations
Only one proposal per human approval
cases.reason: Two separate schema mutations require ordered consent

cases.source: Ya tengo mis recetas apuntadas en notas, añade el tiempo de cocción a todas ellas.
semantic_checks: Don't guess Recipe existing type from the word 'recetas'
Don't attach duration to generic Document
Ask which registered type contains stored recipes
cases.reason: Existing note instances do not establish typed schema identity
